text:
rachael-cs: Quick heads-up  RiverLoop renewal lands next Tuesday. Procurement wants invoices split across two cost centers, a small onboarding credit if they add seats in the first 30 days, and delegated-signer rights limited to invoice acceptance. They also asked to remove bank details from the contract and keep wiring instructions on invoices only. Need legal + finance + billing input before we send the addendum.

dom-acct: Numbers: Current ARR $54,000 (300 seats). Proposal from CS: 12mo, quarterly billing Net30, onboarding credit = 1 week pro rata if seats increased within 30 days, no base price change.

rachael-cs: Customer requested cost-center split 70% / 30% across two internal departments. They will supply two PO numbers once we include split-billing language.

nora-legal: Delegation ok but must be narrow. Draft ask: a one-paragraph "Authorized Invoice Signatory" clause that names the procurement emails or requires a signed delegation letter. Also include language that wiring details are not part of the agreement and will be provided on invoices only. Will post a short addendum draft in the thread.

pablo-finance: Finance: split invoicing accepted only if we map two billing entities or create two linked subscriptions. If we do two linked subscriptions, we need clear seat allocation and two tax IDs (for compliance). For credit exposure, this account doesn't hit our credit-app threshold. Quarterly billing means more AR touchpoints; recommend a 30-day credit check flag for new PO.

ashley-billing: Ops note: our billing system supports linked subscriptions (recommended) or a single invoice with split lines (manual). Linked subscriptions are cleaner and permit separate remit-to. Linked subscriptions need ~24h to provision. If customer wants e-sign today, we can send addendum and perform subscription split after sign. If they insist PO numbers on invoices, set `po_number` metadata on each subscription.

sam-se: From SE - include a short onboarding checklist attached to the addendum. If we give onboarding credit, tie it to completion of the checklist to avoid disputes. Also suggest a seat-change notification window to reduce surprise true-ups.

docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope 5321110050 "RiverLoop Split Billing + Invoice Signatory Addendum" created (status: draft).

rachael-cs: Plan: 1) Nora to post addendum draft within 3 hours; 2) Pablo confirms seat allocation and whether two tax IDs are needed (he flagged it); 3) Ashley prepares billing ops ticket for linked subscriptions; 4) Send DocuSign once legal posts redline. I'll update Gainsight and mark renewal as "pending-approval".

pablo-finance: Confirmed: we need two tax IDs to map remit-to correctly. Please collect those. No credit-app required. Approve legal draft once posted.

nora-legal: Draft posted: short addendum with (a) authorized invoice signatory paragraph requiring named emails or signed delegation, (b) split-billing instructions with seat allocation table placeholder, (c) invoice-only wiring instruction clause, (d) onboarding credit tie to checklist completion. Minimal edits expected.

rachael-cs: Thanks  I'll ask customer for PO numbers, tax IDs, and named delegates now. If they push for wet-signature we escalate to CS manager.

docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope 5321110050 updated  assigned to riverloop-procurement (external) and CS legal for signature routing.

ashley-billing: Billing ops ticket opened (#BILL-8421) to provision two linked subscriptions after signed addendum. ETA ~24h after ticket triage.

pablo-finance: Small note: if they request invoice remittance to a shared mailbox, require a signed acceptance from IT/procurement to avoid spoofing risk.

rachael-cs: Got it. I'll request PO + tax IDs + delegation letter and loop back. Marking renewal risk as low unless DocuSign stalled beyond 48h. :white_check_mark:
